title: Source
description: Metadata a collector declares next to its code. The registry, freshness badges and the Data & Methods page are built from it.

label.description: Human name shown on charts, e.g. 'Greenhouse job board API'.

url.description: Endpoint or page, may contain {placeholders} filled from config/identifiers/<page>.yaml.

cadence.description: How often the source is collected (automated) or expected to be updated (manual/ledger).

sla_days.description: Freshness SLA on retrieved_at: fresh if age <= sla_days, aging if <= 2x, stale beyond, never if no rows.

backfillable.description: False means history cannot be recovered later (snapshot-only): the collector must run continuously.

caveats.description: Known limits a reader must know.
